field.label: Serial port
field.help: All serial ports are listed - be sure to pick the port with the PPS source attached.

field.label: Fudge time
field.help: Fudge time is used to specify the PPS signal offset (in seconds) from the actual second such as the transmission delay between the transmitter and the receiver (default: 0.0).

field.label: Stratum
field.help:
(0-15)
This may be used to change the PPS Clock stratum (default: 0). This may be useful if, for some reason, you want ntpd to prefer a different clock and just monitor this source.

field.label: Clock ID
field.help:
(1 to 4 characters)
This may be used to change the PPS Clock ID (default: PPS).

field.label: Enable falling edge PPS signal processing
Record timestamp once per second
field.help: Useful for constructing Allan deviation plots (default: disabled).
